summary: Your resume shows a solid foundation in marketing through your BBA coursework and hands-on volunteer experience. To make your applications more competitive, you need to replace vague descriptions with specific metrics and clarify your role in group projects.
strengths: Directly relevant volunteer experience managing social media for a campus organization.
Academic project work that aligns well with marketing research fundamentals.

gaps.why: Your Facebook management experience does not mention any outcomes, such as follower growth, reach, or engagement rates, which are critical for marketing roles.
The marketing class project does not specify the size of the survey audience, the tools used to collect data, or how the results were used.
The phrase 'Talked to members' is highly informal and does not explain the communication channels used or the objective of these interactions.
